title: scrape command crashes: scrapers require async context manager
description: psp-etl scrape all --dry-run crashes with RuntimeError: scrapers (AsRockScraper etc.) define __aenter__/__aexit__ for httpx client lifecycle, but _scrape_async in cli.py instantiates them directly with scraper = cls() instead of async with cls() as scraper. Fix: use async context manager in _scrape_async. TDD: write a failing test in tests/test_cli_scrape.py first (mock the scraper's async context manager protocol and list_boards/list_bios_updates), then fix the code.
